summary: Senior PHP developer with 13+ years of experience building and owning complex e-commerce platforms end-to-end (Symfony, Sylius, Magento 2, Shopware 6) — architecture, payment integrations (15+ providers), ERP/CRM synchronization, and CI/CD. Author of open-source plugins for JetBrains and Sylius. Early adopter of AI-assisted engineering: custom MCP tooling, AI-driven E2E testing, and a security-hardened, optimized AI development workflow.

description: Own the global e-commerce platform abrites.com end-to-end — 4 independent legal entities, per-client dynamic pricing, and 15 integrated payment providers, 8 of them implemented from scratch for specific regional requirements.
Designed data validation and normalization across heterogeneous external sources, resolving entity relationships between divergent ERP schemas without direct contextual links.

Maintain the internal ERP/CRM (Python/Django + PostgreSQL), a custom Symfony-based CMS, an event management system, a REST API (Django REST Framework + Swagger), GitLab CI pipelines, and a Dolibarr ERP integration.
Introduced AI-driven end-to-end testing and a security-hardened, optimized vibe-coding workflow (Claude, Codex, Junie) for feature development.
Delivered large-scale Magento (Adobe Commerce) e-commerce projects in close partnership with the Dutch agency Diract.
Customized core functionality, built custom B2B modules and processes, and redesigned the checkout and invoicing pipeline.
Developed and maintained projects across the full range of scale — from landing pages for local businesses to complex systems for banks and insurance companies.
Built custom e-commerce solutions from scratch.
Worked on a variety of small to mid-scale websites and APIs.

educationNote: Self-taught engineer — 13+ years of continuous hands-on learning in production systems, capped by published open-source work on the JetBrains Marketplace and the official Sylius Addons store.
